title: Not sure if this is related to mall world or not ..
content: I keep having this reoccurring dream that I’m in this thrift store except it’s usually longer and there’s two hills behind it one that comes to a flat grass platform with a gas station above it and one that goes down into the back of the thrift store and every time I have the dream it’s usually a nightmare not sure if anyone else can relate but if you’ve also had a similar dream, please let me know in the comments. I’m very curious if this is a part of mall world. The image above is the best representation I can show of it at this moment. I might draw it eventually
